name: flint
description: Flint: keyboard-first quick-capture notes and tasks for developers.
author: Davit Khachaturovi

scripts.build: npm run build -w @flint/core && npm run build -w @flint/cli && npm run build -w @flint/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/cli/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: vitest run --project unit && vitest run --project timing --no-file-parallelism
scripts.check:electron-node: npm run install-electron -w @flint/desktop && npm run check:electron-node -w @flint/desktop
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w @flint/desktop
